# Northgate Store Remodel

- **Goal / definition of done:** refresh the Northgate box — new footwear wall, updated sightlines, refreshed
  front-end and signage — to lift comp and conversion. Target completion before the holiday set.
- **Owner:** Marc, with Merchandising support.
- **Status:** **BLOCKED — stalled at planning/demo.** Cannot proceed to the fixture install phase.
- **⚠️ Blocker (who + why):** the new **fixture package is on hold**, and the person holding it is Regional
  Merchandiser **[Ben Tran](../people/ben-tran.md)** — the region put **fixture spend under a freeze until Q4**,
  so Ben won't release the Northgate fixture allocation yet. *Remodel → fixture package → Ben Tran → budget
  freeze.* Everything downstream waits on that.
- **Second-order dependency:** once fixtures clear, storefront/signage changes still need permit sign-off from
  landlord [Susan Lindqvist](../people/susan-lindqvist.md).
- **Open items:**
  - File the **fixture-budget appeal** through Ben and [Renata Vasquez](../people/renata-vasquez.md)
    (commitment due 2026-08-10).
  - Pre-stage the demo/prep work that doesn't need fixtures.
